Riju is the young [[Gerudo Chief]], ruling over [[Gerudo Town]] after the untimely passing of her mother.<ref name="BotW Buliara"/><ref name="BotW Chief's Diary 2"/> Riju was her mother's only child, causing the duties of leading the Gerudo to fall to her.<ref>{{Cite|Though young, Lady Riju was our old chief's only child, so naturally the duties of leading the Gerudo fell to her.|N/A|BotW}}</ref> Riju resides in the [[Royal Palace]], with her [[Riju's Bedroom|Bedroom]] being located on the second floor. At the time of {{BotW}}, she is approximately 12 years old.<ref name="CaC 137"/>

Throughout her childhood, Riju's mother recounted many stories about the [[Champions]] and the [[Great Calamity]] to her daughter. One of these focused on [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]], which she referred to as a guardian [[Deity]] of the Gerudo.<ref name="Naboris">{{Cite|The Divine Beast Vah Naboris, which supposedly has been sleeping in the desert, has suddenly woken up. Mother once told me that Naboris is the deity of protection for the Gerudo people, but it doesn't seem that way... I plan to investigate tomorrow. I have to find out more...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> She holds a great deal of respect for her ancestor [[Urbosa]],<ref name="CaC 137"/> often remarking that among other ancestors, she must be looking down at them and working to keep them safe.<ref name="Urbosa">{{Cite|Heh, you know... I take heart in having such a rare visitor as yourself. {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}} must be looking out for us.|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref name="Ancestors">{{Cite|I believe that Lady Urbosa and our other ancestors must be looking down on us with such shame right now. I wonder if my people can tell just how powerless their young ruler truly is...|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref name="Arrival">{{Cite|Yes, your arrival in the midst of all of this must be the work of Lady Urbosa...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Similarly, Riju admires [[Nabooru]], one of the [[Sage]]s who sealed [[Calamity Ganon]] when he was still a [[Gerudo]].<ref>{{Cite Book|book= CaC |page= 401}}</ref> Riju also heard stories about [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] placing [[Link]] into a [[Slumber of Restoration]] after he was defeated during the Calamity, as well as Zelda hiding the [[Master Sword]] in a forest.<ref name="Link">{{Cite|Hmm... Buliara, a memory just jumped into my head—something my mother spoke of. When the Calamity happened, the princess of Hyrule placed a fallen swordsman into a deep sleep. That swordsman, much like our new friend here, was named Link...though it always seemed more legend than fact.|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref name="Sword">{{Cite|They do indeed... If I recall correctly, it was called the {{Color BotW|Red|sword that seals the darkness}}. The Princess of Hyrule supposedly hid it away in {{Color BotW|Blue|a forest somewhere}}.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

As evidenced by the [[Sand Seal]] design on her skirt and [[Sand-Seal Toy]]s in her Bedroom, Riju loves Sand Seals.<ref name="CaC 137"/><ref>{{Cite Book|book= CaC |page= 316}}</ref> Prior to her death, Riju's mother gave her [[Patricia]] as a present.<ref>{{Cite|Patricia was a present from the former...from my mother. She turned out to be my first and last gift from her...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Despite Patricia's rugged appearance, Riju regularly dotes on her, and Patricia is always ready to go [[Sand-Seal Surfing]] with her.<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|This is Riju's own sand seal. It may look intense, but she dotes on it regularly; the ribbon it wears was a gift from her, and it even has its own pen in Gerudo Town. It's far more agile than any other sand seal and far more outgoing. An ever-reliable partner to Riju, Patricia is always ready to take off through the desert at a moment's notice.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> The red ribbon that Patricia wears was a gift to her from Riju.<ref name="Compendium"/>

Riju keeps a journal known as the ''[[Chief's Diary]]'', which she keeps in her Bedroom.<ref name="BotW Chief's Diary"/> She started the ''Diary'' shortly after the death of her mother, which [[Buliara]] informed her of.<ref name="BotW Chief's Diary 2"/> While Buliara told Riju that her mother was in a better place, Riju could not understand how it could be better if they were apart.<ref name="BotW Chief's Diary 2"/> After becoming the Gerudo Chief, Riju noticed that the people of Gerudo Town started acting nicer to her, but she still saw worry in their eyes.<ref>{{Cite|Ever since I became the chief, the people in town have been a lot nicer to me. But if I look carefully, I can still see the worry in their eyes. It seems more common than when Mother was chief...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> As a result, she wonders if she could be as great of a Chief as her mother was.<ref>{{Cite|Mother... Will I ever be as great a chief as you were?|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref>

When [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]] reactivated and began roaming the [[East Barrens]], Riju planned to investigate it, claiming that it seemed to be acting contrary to her mother's words.<ref name="Naboris"/> She approached the Divine Beast with Patricia, but she decided to turn back after encountering its [[Sandstorm]] and [[Lightning]].<ref>{{Cite|When I drew close to it, using my wonderful sand seal Patricia, I was driven back by a sandstorm and lightning.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> However, Patricia was scared by a [[Monster]], resulting in them turning directly towards Divine Beast Vah Naboris.<ref>{{Cite|I turned Patricia toward home, but a monster spooked her, and she fled directly toward Naboris again...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> The next thing Riju is able to recall was being rescued by Buliara.<ref>{{Cite|The next thing I remember is Buliara standing over me, her face full of worry.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> Afterwards, Riju concluded that the Gerudo would be in grave danger if Divine Beast Vah Naboris attacked them.<ref>{{Cite|Having investigated Divine Vah Naboris, I can say that if it came to Gerudo Town, we'd be helpless.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref>

Following Riju's encounter with Divine Beast Vah Naboris, Buliara refused to leave her side.<ref>{{Cite|Ever since I went to investigate the Divine Beast, Buliara has made a point of never leaving my side.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> This continued even after the [[Thunder Helm]] was stolen from the Royal Palace, which Riju fears happened due to her being unprepared to be the Gerudo Chief.<ref>{{Cite|Even now, with such a valuable heirloom stolen by thieves, she refuses to tear herself away from me even for a moment. She takes all the blame for the theft, however. Nothing can change her mind about being responsible. Meanwhile, I can't help but feel that the theft happened because I am not yet ready to be chief...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> Though no one has said as much, Riju believes that the soldiers consider her to be powerless.<ref>{{Cite|The soldiers search tirelessly, trying to recover the heirloom. No one says a word about my leadership... But they must be thinking about how powerless their chief has proven to be.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> Even after the [[Yiga|Yiga Clan]] were identified as the thieves, the Gerudo were unable to approach their [[Yiga Clan Hideout|Hideout]].<ref>{{Cite|Thanks to the tireless efforts of my soldiers, we've located the thieves' hideout. They definitely aren't common criminals, though. We haven't been able to get anywhere close to the place. To think that the Thunder Helm is right there, yet we can't take it back...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> In desperation, Riju prayed to her mother and Urbosa for guidance.<ref>{{Cite|Mother... Lady Urbosa... Please give me your guidance...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref>

Contrary to Riju's opinion of herself, the soldiers directly guarding the Royal Palace express admiration towards her, referring to her as kind and warning travelers to avoid offending her.<ref>{{Cite|If you want to go inside, be my guest. But if you say even one rude thing to the chief... You and my spear will have a very personal conversation!|Ploka|BotW}}</ref><ref name="Reeza">{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|chief}} may be young, but she's a kind person who puts her people first. She even told me to allow visitors through, even in these though times... Hey, listen! Even though I'm letting you inside, that doesn't mean you can go getting in the {{Color BotW|Blue|chief}}'s way! Watch out!|Reeza|BotW}}</ref> Riju has also kept the Palace open to visitors, despite Gerudo Town's state of emergency.<ref name="Reeza"/><ref>{{Cite|[Can I go in?] {{Big|We're busy! It's an emergency!! Authorized personnel only!!!}} ...That's what I would say if I had my way, but the {{Color BotW|Blue|chief}} is a kind person. She's told me to allow visitors.|Ploka|BotW}}</ref>

[[File:BotW Riju Introduction.png|thumb|left|250px|alt= A screenshot of Riju in the Royal Palace's Throne Room. Text on-screen displays her name, along with the title "Gerudo Chief".|Riju's introduction]]
When Link first enters the [[Royal Palace's Throne Room]], Riju will greet him from her [[Riju's Throne|Throne]], wondering how he managed to reach the Palace.<ref>{{Cite|Yet another traveler... How did you get in here?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She then notices the [[Sheikah Slate]] on Link's hip, which piques her interest.<ref>{{Cite|It seems you have something rather interesting there...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Buliara will then stop Link and demand he explain his business.<ref name="BotW Buliara"/> Riju calms Buliara, stating that Link appears to be special and asking his name.<ref>{{Cite|Hold on, Buliara... This one appears to be more than a common traveler. You there—what is your name?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> After hearing his name, she asks what it is that he came to tell her.<ref>{{Cite|Link... And what is it you've come all the way here to tell me, Link?|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Upon hearing that Link can calm Divine Beast Vah Naboris, Buliara is sceptical, since he is not a [[Champions|Champion]] like Riju's ancestor Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|[I can calm Naboris.] You think you have what it takes to subdue something so powerful as a Divine Beast? The only ones who could ever control them were Champions like Lady Urbosa. And all of the Champions died in the {{Color BotW|Red|Calamity}} 100 years ago.|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> Riju suddenly recalls her mother's tales about Link, noting that the two have the same name.<ref name="Link"/> If Link does not yet have the Master Sword, Buliara will point this out to Riju.<ref>{{Cite|But, Lady Riju! Do those same stories not also say that the Hylian Champion carried a {{Color BotW|Red|legendary sword}}? I see no such weapon in this person's care.|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> Riju cites legends that Zelda hid it in a forest.<ref name="Sword"/> She also points out Link's Sheikah Slate, reasoning that the [[Sheikah]] would not allow just anybody to carry it around.<ref>{{Cite|What of the device on this one's hip? It appears to be a precious relic of the Sheikah. I can't imagine they would give something so valuable to a simple drifter—can you?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> While attempting to remember stories of the Champions, Buliara realizes that Link must be a man.<ref>{{Cite|...I don't remember ever hearing of a Hylian vai among the Champions. Wait a moment... You're a voe!|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> Though men are not allowed within Gerudo Town, Riju decides to allow Link to stay, especially since he has offered to help them face Divine Beast Vah Naboris.<ref>{{Cite|A voe within our walls in a great crime. But a voe who is a {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion}}... Well, we'd never mistreat a friend of {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}}. And if you're here to help us with {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}}, then we are allies.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Riju informs Link that the Gerudo have yet to find a way to appease Divine Beast Vah Naboris.<ref>{{Cite|You saw it on your way to our town. {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Naboris}}, cloaked in a massive sandstorm, hurling lightning at any who dare approach. We have to do something to stop it, but we have yet to find any way to appease the {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast}} on our own.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She reasons that if Link is truly a Champion, he will be able to enter and calm Vah Naboris.<ref>{{Cite|If you truly are a Champion, perhaps you will be able to enter {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}} and calm its anger|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Buliara urges Riju not to trust a stranger with such an important task, suggesting that he prove himself worthy by recovering the stolen Thunder Helm.<ref>{{Cite|Lady Riju! I don't see how you can trust a complete stranger with something as important as this task. Perhaps if this person were first to prove his worth by recovering your stolen Thunder Helm...|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> Riju agrees with this suggestion, and she proceeds to explain that the Thunder Helm is the only thing in [[Hyrule]] that can withstand Divine Beast Vah Naboris's Lightning.<ref>{{Cite|Ah, yes... An interesting suggestion. You see, there is only one thing in all of Hyrule that can withstand the {{Color BotW|Blue|lightning}} from {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}}.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> However, she reveals that her family heirloom has been stolen.<ref>{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|Thunder Helm}}, a family heirloom and relic of the Gerudo. But as Buliara says, it was stolen from us.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Buliara assures Riju that, as a Champion, Link should easily be able to retrieve the Helm.<ref>{{Cite|You needn't worry, Lady Riju. If he truly is a Champion, this should be an easy task for him.|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> She directs Link to [[Teake|Captain Teake]] in the [[Barracks]] nearby to learn more about the thieves.<ref>{{Cite|Our soldiers can tell you all you need to know about the thieves who stole Lady Riju's heirloom. Head through this arch. It will lead you to the barracks. Then, seek out {{Color BotW|Blue|Captain Teake}}, and ask for a full report.|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> Before Link leaves, Riju states that his arrival must be a sign that Urbosa is looking out for them.<ref name="Urbosa"/> This starts the "[[Divine Beast Vah Naboris (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]" [[Main Quest]].

If Link speaks to Riju again, she expresses her disbelief that the Thunder Helm could have been stolen, referring to it as the most discouraging event to ever occur in Gerudo Town.<ref>{{Cite|I can't believe my {{Color BotW|Blue|heirloom}} was stolen! This is probably the most discouraging event this town has ever seen...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju believes that Urbosa and her other ancestors are looking down on them with shame, and she wonders if her people can tell how powerless she is.<ref name="Ancestors"/> Buliara intervenes, telling Riju not to take it personally and that the soldiers and herself are to blame, commenting that she should have been more vigilant.<ref>{{Cite|My lady, do not take this crisis so personally! This failure rests entirely on myself and on the soldiers tasked with protecting the heirloom. If only I'd been more vigilant...|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> Riju then tells Buliara that she does not need to beat herself up about it.<ref>{{Cite|You needn't beat yourself up in my stead, Buliara...|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Once Link returns from the [[Yiga Clan Hideout]] with the Thunder Helm, he will be directed to meet with Riju outside of her Bedroom.<ref>{{Cite|If you are looking for {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Riju}}, she's on the {{Color BotW|Red|second floor}}. Normally people aren't allowed into her sleeping quarters, but she has given you permission it seems... Be on your best manners. If she deems you to be a disturbance to her, it will not end well for you!|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> When Link approaches her, she is able to sense the power of the Thunder Helm on his person.<ref>{{Cite|I've been waiting for you... Oh, you needn't say a word. As the chief of the Gerudo, I can sense the power of the heirloom flowing from you. I know that you've succeeded!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju confesses her insecurities about becoming a leader at such a young age, claiming that she has tried to prove her worth to both her people and herself.<ref>{{Cite|I am, as you have no doubt noticed, still but a child. The people look on me with nothing but warmth in their eyes, but even this brings me some pain, I must admit. I've tried so hard to be worthy of their love, to be a worthy chief...and to prove to myself that I was worthy, too.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> As a result, the theft of the Thunder Helm left her feeling disheartened.<ref>{{Cite|When my family heirloom was stolen, I felt as though a shadow had fallen over me...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She once again credits Urbosa for Link's arrival in Gerudo Town.<ref name="Arrival"/> Riju then asks Link to hand her the Thunder Helm. After equipping the Helm, she quietly asks Link how she looks.<ref>{{Cite|{{Small|Um. How do I look?}}|Riju|BotW}}</ref> This causes Link to recall the "[[Urbosa's Hand]]" [[Recovered Memory]].

Once the Recovered Memory ends, Riju notes that Link is staring at her, but she proclaims this does not matter and reiterates her previous question.<ref>{{Cite|What's wrong? You're just staring... Anyway, what matters now is... How...how is it?! Do I look all right?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link tells Riju it looks good, Riju will be comforted, though it then proceeds to slightly slip off her head.<ref>{{Cite|[It looks good!] I see...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link admits that the Thunder Helm is too big for her, the Helm slips off to the side, which Riju makes a dry remark about.<ref>{{Cite|[It's a tad big...] ... ...You don't say.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Returning to the task at hand, Riju admits that, with the threat of Divine Beast Vah Naboris growing, she fears Gerudo Town may soon become a target.<ref>{{Cite|The threat {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Naboris}} poses has only grown since we began searching for the heirloom. I believe that Gerudo Town itself may be in danger before too long...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She feels that, as both the Gerudo Chief and a Gerudo herself, she is responsible for protecting her people, and she asks Link if he is willing to help her.<ref>{{Cite|As chief, and as a Gerudo, I must find some way to stop that thing before it threatens my people. Will you help me?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Link's simple assurance puts her at ease.<ref>{{Cite|[Of course!] Heheh, who would have thought that, just before such a momentous battle... hearing a simple, confident pledge of support from you would be what puts me at ease?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju tells Link to meet her at the [[Lookout Post]] to prepare for the attack on Divine Beast Vah Naboris.<ref>{{Cite|I'll head out now. Let's meet up at the {{Color BotW|Red|lookout post}} {{Color BotW|Blue|south of town}}.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Since the only way to approach Vah Naboris is by riding a Sand Seal, Riju suggests he ride one to the Lookout Post to get some practice.<ref>{{Cite|There's only one way to get close to {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}}, and that's with the help of a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}. The {{Color BotW|Red|lookout post}} isn't too far from town, but you should take a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}} there. You can get some practice in that way.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Both Riju and Patricia will be waiting there for him.<ref name="BotW Riju"/> Before she leaves, the Thunder Helm once again slips off her head, and she laments that it is too big.<ref>{{Cite|Still... It really is a little big...|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

When Link arrives to the Lookout Post, he will be able to find Riju at the very top. If he is not wearing the [[Gerudo Outfit]], she notes that it is uncommon for her to meet a man.<ref>{{Cite|Well then... That's what you really look like, huh... Hehe... With voe banned from town, it's not very common for me to see someone lik you.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She then remarks that Divine Beast Vah Naboris is intimidating, and she asks Link if he is ready to face it.<ref>{{Cite|What a sight. {{Color BotW|Red|Divine Beast Vah Naboris}} is pretty intimidating... If we want to get close enough to that thing, we'll need to use {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}}... Are you ready?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link confirms that he is, Riju goes over their plan, which involves drawing close to the Divine Beast with their Sand Seals.<ref>{{Cite|[Of course!] Feeling confident? Good. Let's get going, then! First, we'll use the {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} to get in really close to that thing. I'll take the lead.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Once he is close, Link must shoot its feet with [[Bomb Arrow]]s, which will disrupt its ability to drag energy from the ground.<ref>{{Cite|I'm counting on you to {{Color BotW|Blue|shoot}} at its feet with {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}. Naboris draws energy from the ground to keep moving. If you damage the feet, I think you can stop it.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She also instructs Link to stay close to her to avoid getting shocked by Lightning, since the Thunder Helm will be able to shield a small area around her.<ref>{{Cite|Those lightning strike, though... Getting hit even once could prove fatal. The {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}} can repel the lightning strikes, protecting me from harm. But it can also shield a limited area around me... You'll have to stay close if you don't want to be shocked.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Should Link become too injured to keep going, Riju tells him to return to the Lookout Post.<ref>{{Cite|And listen... If you're too injured to keep fighting, promise me {{Color BotW|Red|you'll retreat here, to the lookout post}}. Don't do anything reckless under any circumstances.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Lastly, Riju gives Link a bundle of 20 [[Bomb Arrow]]s to use during the fight.<ref>{{Cite|Here are some Gerudo {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}. There aren't many, so be sure to put them to good use.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

[[File:BotW Riju Thunder Helm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|alt= A screenshot of Riju wearing the Thunder Helm. Patricia can be seen in the distance. Her dialogue reads "Oh, wow! I can feel their power coursing through me!"|Riju after activating the Thunder Helm]]
Riju then asks Link to once again confirm he is ready.<ref>{{Cite|This is the last time I'll ask... Are you ready?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> When Link confirms that he is, the pair will depart for the East Barrens. Before they begin, Riju asks Link to give her some space.<ref>{{Cite|Could you give me a bit of room, just for a moment?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Holding her arms skyward, Riju introduces herself as a descendant of the royal line and leader of the Gerudo and declares that she will calm Divine Beast Vah Naboris.<ref>{{Cite|My name is Riju, descendant of the royal line and leader of the Gerudo people! With the power of the heirloom passed down in my family, I shall calm the {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Naboris}}.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She then gathers power by asking her ancestors to aid her.<ref>{{Cite|Ancestors of the Gerudo! Answer my call! Aid me in this task!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Green energy will then form a forcefield around Riju, and she claims that she can feel her ancestors' power flowing through her.<ref>{{Cite|Oh, wow! I can feel their power coursing through me!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> After fixing her askew Thunder Helm, she declares that it is time for them to move.<ref>{{Cite|Let's move!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Turning away from Link, she asks Urbosa to protect them both.<ref>{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}}... Please grant Link and me your protection...|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Link and Riju then Surf their Sand Seals into Divine Beast Vah Naboris's Sandstorm. Link must ride close to Riju in order to avoid being struck by Lightning. During the battle, Riju will prompt Link about when to strike the Divine Beast's feet.<ref>{{Cite|Not yet!|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Link, now!|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|All right! Now!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She will also warn him of impending Lightning strikes and urge him to stay close to her.<ref>{{Cite|Stay close to me!|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Look out!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Whenever Link deactivates one of the feet, Riju will praise him.<ref>{{Cite|Good!|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|That's the way!|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|We can do this!|Riju|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Good, Link!|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

[[File:BotW Link and Riju.png|thumb|left|250px|alt= A screenshot of Riju and Link standing before Divine Beast Vah Naboris, which has collapsed to the ground. Their Sand Seals are positioned at either side of them.|Riju and Link after fighting Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]
After Divine Beast Vah Naboris collapses, Link and Riju regroup. Removing the Thunder Helm, Riju states that she is unable to appease Naboris, and she leaves the rest of the task to Link.<ref>{{Cite|Unfortunately, I cannot appease Naboris on my own. I have no choice but to entrust the rest to you.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> As she watches Link enter the Divine Beast, she tells him not to let them down.<ref>{{Cite|Don't let us down, Link.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

When Link returns to the Royal Palace after freeing Divine Beast Vah Naboris, Riju will be relieved to see him.<ref>{{Cite|Oh, you're back?! I'm glad you're OK... {{Small|Truly, I am...}}|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Though she is still worried about the fate of Hyrule, she is comforted to have dealt with the immediate threat to Gerudo Town.<ref>{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}} is no longer a threat to the town... I'm still worried about the larger threat to Hyrule, but at least my people won't be troubled by {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}} anymore.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> As thanks for Link's help, Riju offers him the contents of two [[Treasure Chest]]s behind her Throne, which she claims are priceless pieces of equipment that were once worn by Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|I want to offer you these as thanks for your help. I trust you'll accept them. These pieces of equipment are priceless treasures of the Gerudo people. They were once worn by {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}}.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She believes that it is right for Link to have them because he and Urbosa were once friends.<ref>{{Cite|Since you and {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}} were friends, it's only right that you have them.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> The Chests contain the [[Arms of the Seven|Champion's Arms]], the [[Daybreaker]] and the [[Scimitar of the Seven]]. Once Riju and Link's conversation ends, the "Divine Beast Vah Naboris" Main Quest will be completed.

Afterwards, Riju will claim that she heard a voice calling her name while fighting Divine Beast Vah Naboris, which she believes to have been Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|When I wore the {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}} and fought along your side, I thought I heard a name called out on the wind. Riju... Heh, I hadn't been called by that name in a while. That strong, warm voice...It must have belonged to Urbosa...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link responds by calling Riju by her name, Buliara will scold him for doing so.<ref>{{Cite|[Riju...] Such insolence! Even deeds as valorous as yours do not earn you the right to speak so to the chief!|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> However, Riju tells Buliara to let it pass, since she enjoys hearing her name.<ref>{{Cite|Hm hm hm... Let it go, Buliara. Being called by my name every once in a while isn't so bad.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

With Divine Beast Vah Naboris calmed, Riju makes a new entry in the ''Chief's Diary'', where she refers to Link as the answer to her prayers.<ref>{{Cite|My prayers were answered! One of the Champions of old has appeared!|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> She notes that, while Buliara was initially wary of Link, she trusts him after he was able to retrieve the Thunder Helm.<ref>{{Cite|Buliara was wary, but he has proven himself by taking our heirloom back from the thieves and calming Naboris. She now seems to trust his abilities. She even seems to not mind that he is a voe.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> This surprises Riju, since she has always known Buliara to follow the rules.<ref>{{Cite|She's so focused and serious. Always by the book. I'm surprised she's OK with him.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref>

When Link examines the Thunder Helm next to Riju's Throne, Buliara will stop him, since his status as a hero does not permit him to take the heirloom.<ref>{{Cite|{{Big|Halt! That is the treasure of the Gerudo, the {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}}!}} You may be held in high esteem, but this does not give you the freedom to lay your hands on the pride of our people.|Buliara|BotW}}</ref> However, Riju interjects, calming Buliara and asking Link if he desires the Helm.<ref>{{Cite|Becalm yourself, Buliara. You...desire this helm?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link confirm that he wants it, Riju claims that she is unable to give him something so precious.<ref>{{Cite|[I want it!] I see... And yet, despite the great debt we owe you, I cannot just give such a precious thing to you.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Since Link is facing that same enemy as Urbosa, though, Riju decides that she can lend it to him.<ref>{{Cite|...But you ARE up against the enemy of Lady Urbosa... And if you truly desire it, then perhaps I can lend it to you...|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Should Link agree to borrow it, Riju reveals that he must gain the trust of the Gerudo in order to prove he is worthy of borrowing such a cultural treasure.<ref>{{Cite|[Yes! Lend it to me!] Well then, let's see how serious you are. This helm is a cultural treasure. To earn, it, you must gain the trust of our people.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> To do this, he must bring peace back to Gerudo Town by solving the problems of those who live there.<ref>{{Cite|I want you to address their concerns and bring a resolute peace to our town.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> This starts "[[The Thunder Helm]]" [[Side Quest]]. Riju reminds Link that he cannot fix Gerudo Town with only power.<ref>{{Cite|We already know that you are powerful. But you can't solve all of my people's problems with power alone.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

If Link speaks to Riju while the Side Quest is active, she states that some of Urbosa's power remains within the Thunder Helm.<ref>{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}} still holds some of Urbosa's power.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> As a result, she cannot allow Link to wield that power until he has proven himself to be a friend of the Gerudo.<ref>{{Cite|If you want to wield that power, then you must address the concerns of my people and bring a resolute peace to our town. Then you will be acknowledged as a friend of the Gerudo, and only then will I lend the helm to you.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

After "The Thunder Helm" is started, the final entry will appear in the ''Chief's Diary''. Riju admits that she wanted to give him the Thunder Helm outright, but she had to uphold the value it has to the Gerudo.<ref>{{Cite|He has returned to us. It seems he has need of my family heirloom, the {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}}. I want to simply lend it to him without thought, but it is incredibly valuable to myself and our people... I couldn't just hand it over, so I asked him to help with the minor problems plaguing the town...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> She recounts that she used to spend so much time worrying about the Gerudo and whether she would be able to lead them, but she believes that Link helped her learn to look toward the future.<ref>{{Cite|It's funny... I used to spend a lot of my time worrying about my people or my ability to lead... Now I look forward to each and every day... I think this hero helped with that.|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref> One day, she hopes that the two of them can face each other in a [[Sand-Seal Race]].<ref>{{Cite|Maybe one day he and I can compete in a sand-seal race. I'd enjoy that...|Chief's Diary|BotW}}</ref>

After completing all of the Side Quests in Gerudo Town, Link can return to Riju, who tells him that she has heard of his actions in delivering happiness to her people.<ref>{{Cite|I have heard of your recent actions. You have returned smiles to the faces of my people...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju thanks Link on behalf of her people, stating that he will always be a true friend of the Gerudo.<ref>{{Cite|On behalf of all the Gerudo, I must offer you my heartfelt thanks. Sarqso. You are, from this moment on, a true friend of the Gerudo!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> As a reward, Riju keeps her promise and lends Link the Thunder Helm.<ref>{{Cite|And if it can help a true friend in need, we will gladly lend you this sacred treasure.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju assures Link that he will be able to use the Thunder Helm to its full potential, and she believes he will be able to unlock the power of Urbosa left inside.<ref>{{Cite|I know that you, more than any other, will be able to use this {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}} to its fullest potential... I believe you can unlock the power of Urbosa that lies within.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

Once "The Thunder Helm" is completed, Riju will take up a daily schedule throughout the Royal Palace. In the mornings, she wakes up at 7:00 AM to head to the [[Palace Courtyard]] and speak with Patricia, which she previously did before Divine Beast Vah Naboris's rampage began.<ref>{{Cite|It's normally part of my morning routine to have a chat with Patricia before I start my day... But with the Divine Beast causing so much havoc, I haven't had much time until now to come visit her.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link speaks to her, she divulges that Patricia has the ability to deliver divine messages in return for [[Fruit]], though she can only be understood by a select few.<ref>{{Cite|Patricia has a mysterious power... If you feed some fruit to her, she will deliver divine messages. But the messages can only be understood by those who are able to truly communicate with her.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> [[Padda]], who takes care of Patricia, notes that Riju is returning to her regular self now that Gerudo Town is safe.<ref>{{Cite|You are in the chief's presence now. Please behave appropriately. I ask this because she appears to have returned to her normal, kind self. It's such a relief to see her happy again. I consider it my duty to protect her good mood at all costs.|Padda|BotW}}</ref>

When Link talks to Riju during the day, she asks if he is still worried about Gerudo Town's safety.<ref>{{Cite|What's wrong? Are you still worried about the safety of this town?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She also wonders if he is so comfortable in Gerudo Town that he cannot imagine leaving.<ref>{{Cite|Or have you grown so comfortable here that you can't imagine leaving?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju reminds Link that he is needed elsewhere and will need to leave eventually, though she welcomes him to stay in Gerudo Town whenever he would like after saving Hyrule.<ref>{{Cite|Whatever the case may be, you're needed elsewhere. You must eventually leave. You know this. That being said... When it's all over, if you were to drop back by here... I think we'd all be pleased to see you.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> On her way to her Bedroom, Riju is relieved to have finished her work for the day.<ref>{{Cite|Phew... I think that's everything I needed to do as chief today.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She recalls that affairs were hectic when Divine Beast Vah Naboris was active, and she is relieved that Link was able to calm it.<ref>{{Cite|When the Divine Beast was still causing havoc everywhere, I didn't have much time at all to relax. Thanks to you, I now have time to catch my breath. I'm really grateful.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

[[File:BotW Riju Playing.png|thumb|right|250px|alt= A screenshot of Riju inside her bedroom, appearing excited in front of a Sand-Seal Toy.|Riju playing with her Sand-Seal Toys]]
At 8:00 PM, Riju returns to her Bedroom. While there, she plays with her [[Red-Seal Toy]].<ref>{{Cite|What should we play?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> If Link approaches her during this time, she will become embarrassed, telling him to ignore the Toys.<ref>{{Cite|Wh-what?! The sand-seal stuffed animals? Don't worry about them! Just... Just ignore them, OK?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She then turns on Link, calling him rude for entering someone's room at night.<ref>{{Cite|Besides, town hero or no, you shouldn't just come wandering into someone's room at this time of night!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Later on in the night, she spends time reading the tablet in the back of the room, where she remarks that her mother's soul is always with her.<ref>{{Cite|My mother may not be here in the flesh, but her soul is with me...always.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She expresses her belief that her mother led Link to Gerudo town in some way.<ref>{{Cite|I have no doubt she led you here... Ha! Fate works in mysterious ways.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> While she is heading to bed at 3:00 AM, she will tell Link that he cannot stay in her Bedroom.<ref>{{Cite|What? You don't have a place to stay? Well, you can't stay here!|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She instead directs him to the [[Hotel Oasis]], which she has heard good things about.<ref>{{Cite|There's a perfectly fine hotel in town. The soldiers speak highly of some kind of rejuvenating experience there. I can barely keep my eyes open right now... Sav'orq...|Riju|BotW}}</ref> In her sleep, Riju mumbles about her mother.<ref>{{Cite|{{Small|Mother...}}|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

During {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack, Link gains the ability to ask Riju about Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|[Tell me about Urbosa.] You wish to speak of {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}}? Hm, what an interesting request.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She reveals that the Gerudo discovered ''[[Urbosa's Diary]]'' after Divine Beast Vah Naboris was calmed, and she learned that Urbosa was friends with the late [[Queen of Hyrule]].<ref>{{Cite|After {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}} was tamed, we located {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa's diary}}. Since you're here, I shall tell you something from it. {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}} had a beloved friend whom she thought the world of... {{Color BotW|Blue|the queen of Hyrule}}. Such a big heart... Our {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}} was admirable in every aspect of her life.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> When Link asks about the ''Diary'', Riju discloses that it is in her bedroom, and she is certain Urbosa would trust him to read it.<ref>{{Cite|[Urbosa's diary?] {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa's diary}} is in {{Color BotW|Blue|my room}}. Since she trusted you, I'm certain she wouldn't mind you reading it.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> At the end of their conversation, Riju proclaims that Urbosa is smiling upon them, and she resolves to protect the fragile peace of Gerudo Town.<ref>{{Cite|Lady Urbosa smiles upon us once more. I must protect our fragile peace.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

When the "[[EX Champion Urbosa's Song]]" [[Main Quest]] is active, Link is able to ask Riju about the [[Sacred Orb]] of the Gerudo.<ref>{{Cite|[The treasured orb?] Are you referring to the treasure of the Gerudo? The {{Color BotW|Red|sacred orb}} kept safe by my people for generations?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Through this, she realizes that Link is attempting to challenge the same [[Divine Beast Tamer's Trial]] that Urbosa did 100 years ago.<ref>{{Cite|Link... Answer truly. Are you challenging the same trial that {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Urbosa}} overcame all those years ago?|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She confesses that the Sacred Orb was stolen by the Yiga Clan, just as the Thunder Helm was.<ref>{{Cite|In that case, I shall not keep this a secret from you. Our {{Color BotW|Red|treasured orb}} was stolen. Yet another massive failure...as though the incident with the {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}} wasn't humiliating enough. To top it all off, the ones who stole the treasure were none other than our sworn enemies, the {{Color BotW|Red|Yiga Clan}}.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Only Riju and Buliara are aware that the Sacred Orb is missing.<ref>{{Cite|Luckily, the first ot notice its absence was {{Color BotW|Blue|Buliara}}. As of now, she and I are the only members of our tribe who know.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Once again, Riju asks Link to recover their treasure from the Yiga Clan Hideout, allowing him to use the Sacred Orb however he needs to in order to complete the Trial.<ref>{{Cite|Link... Would you be willing to help us recover a sacred treasure from those fiends once more? In return, you must use the {{Color BotW|Red|treasure orb}} however you please to complete the trial.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> She contemplates that it may be fate that Link would recover the Sacred Orb he needs for the Trial, and she wishes him luck in doing so.<ref>{{Cite|Perhaps it is fate, as that {{Color BotW|Red|orb}} was made to be used for the very trial you are challenging. I wish you luck in finding it.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> Riju apologizes for yet again having Link solve the problems of the Gerudo, but she says that she is counting on him.<ref>{{Cite|I'm sorry to burden you with my troubles again, but...I'm counting on you.|Riju|BotW}}</ref>

During the "[[Rescue Across Time: Air and Lightning]]" [[Movie]] that plays before the "[[Air and Lightning|Air and Lighting]]" [[Scenario]] begins, Riju and [[Patricia]] exit one of [[Terrako]]'s portals and arrive inside [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]], where they save [[Urbosa]] from [[Thunderblight Ganon]]. Urbosa is shocked by Riju's sudden appearance,<ref>{{Cite|Where did you...?|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> but Riju insists that they should focus on the fight first and foremost.<ref>{{Cite|Lady Urbosa... For now, let us focus on winning this fight.|Riju|AoC}}</ref>

After one of the Warriors enters Divine Beast Vah Naboris, the "[[Avatar of the Calamity: Thunderblight Ganon]]" Movie begins. Leaning against Patricia, Riju laments that she is not strong enough to protect Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|I thought...I was strong enough to protect you.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> In response, Urbosa places a hand on Riju's shoulder, assuring her that she bought them time for the other Warriors to appear.<ref>{{Cite|Listen. You bought us much-needed time. Now look who's come to help|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> As the battle with Thunderblight Ganon begins, Riju recognizes the Warrior that came to help them, but she decides that they need to defeat their enemy first.<ref>{{Cite|You! Actually... We'll talk later. I need your help!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> During the fight, she also complains about Thunderblight Ganon's speed,<ref>{{Cite|Guh... That monster really is quite fast.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> to which Urbosa instructs her to focus on the gaps in its defenses.<ref>{{Cite|Unvarnished brute force will not serve us. Focus on the gaps in the enemy's defenses.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref>

Once Thunderblight Ganon has been vanquished, Urbosa thanks Riju and the Warrior for rescuing her.<ref>{{Cite|I am not accustomed to being in need of rescue. Regardless, thank you.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> She then uses Divine Beast Vah Naboris's [[Lightning]] to destroy the top of [[Mount Rhoam]], creating [[Updraft]]s that allow the Warriors access to [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]].<ref>{{Cite|So now we have to board Vah Medoh in the skies, hm? I know just the way...|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> After doing so, however, she becomes to tired to continue fighting, so Riju joins the Warriors in her stead.<ref>{{Cite|Lady Urbosa is exhausted from battle, so I will accompany you. Let's hurry to Mount Rhoam!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> At this time, Riju is unlocked as a playable Warrior.<ref>{{Cite|You can now play as {{Color AoC|Blue|Riju}}!|Battle Log|AoC}}</ref> She tells her fellow Warriors to meet up with the [[Rito Soldier]]s nearby, believing they would be capable of opening the [[Outpost]] gates that block their path.<ref>{{Cite|I heard Rito warriors were nearby... Perhaps they can enter the outpost and open the gates.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> Upon finding the [[Rito Captain]]s under attack, Riju decides that they must help them in order to proceed.<ref>{{Cite|We can't proceed because of the monster assault. That means we'll need to clear them out!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> Following this, the Rito Captains open the gates for them, though they warn the Warriors about a White-Maned Lynel on top of Mount Rhoam.<ref>{{Cite|Wonderful, they stayed true to their word. Be careful out there!|Rito Captain|AoC}}</ref> When the White-Maned Lynel is defeated, Riju directs one of the Warriors to ride the Updraft while the others provide support from the ground.<ref>{{Cite|Now, it's time to ride the updrafts. At the end of the Scenario, the "[[Counterattack: Air and Lightning]]" Movie plays, Riju gathers with Urbosa on top of Divine Beast Vah Medoh. Urbosa thanks the Warriors for their help, specifically singling out Riju for saving her.<ref>{{Cite|Now then... First, I owe you my gratitude. Thank you for your help. Truly.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|And second... Riju, you said? We—all of us—fought as one.|Riju|AoC}}</ref>

At the outset of the "[[Each Step Like Thunder]]" Quest, the "[[Vah Naboris's Pilots]]" Movie plays. Using Divine Beast Vah Naboris, Urbosa and Riju attempt to stem the amount of [[Guardian]]s coming from [[Hyrule Field]].<ref>{{Cite|Urbosa and Riju took control of Vah Naboris, working to stem the never-ending flow of Guardians.|Narration|AoC}}</ref> From on top of Divine Beast Vah Naboris, the pair overlook the hordes of Guardians. Riju compares the sight to a nightmare,<ref>{{Cite|This is like a nightmare.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> but Urbosa reassures her that they can defeat them together.<ref>{{Cite|You needn't sound so defeated. Together, we'll put a stop to it.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> Riju is still unconvinced, asking how they can manage to fight against such a massive horde.<ref>{{Cite|But how? Look how many there are!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> Kneeling down to be eye level with Riju, Urbosa reminds Riju that if it were not for her, they would not have been able to pilot Divine Beast Vah Naboris, and she believes nothing will be able to stop them.<ref>{{Cite|I would likely have died if it wasn't for your courage. But I'm still here, and Naboris still has its pilot. I'd wager nothing can stop us.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> Riju nods, finally agreeing with Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|We will triumph.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> Stepping forward, Urbosa asks Riju to take her hand.<ref>{{Cite|Well then, let's begin. Will you take my hand?|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> When Riju does so, the pair jump off Naboris's head and into its body, causing Riju to scream in excitement.

While fighting the Guardians, Urbosa states that as two [[Gerudo]] women, the odds are in their favor.<ref>{{Cite|A pack of Guardians against two Gerudo vai? I like our chances. Come on!|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> Riju agrees with her, promising to help as best she can despite her lack of experience.<ref>{{Cite|OK! Though I lack your experience, I swear to do my best to help!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> She admits to Urbosa that she has struggled with her inexperience ever since coming to her aid,<ref>{{Cite|Since throwing myself into this conflict, I've battled with my lack of experience...|Riju|AoC}}</ref> but Urbosa insists that she has proven to her that the Gerudo will thrive once she is gone.<ref>{{Cite|Nonsense! I have never felt more certain that the Gerudo will thrive after I am gone.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> After defeating many of the [[Guardian]]s heading to [[Fort Hateno]], Urbosa proclaims that Riju is a strong ally.<ref>{{Cite|That is most of the ones headed for Fort Hateno dealt with. You are a powerful ally, Riju!|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> In return, Riju expresses her desire to one day be as powerful as Urbosa.<ref>{{Cite|I hope one day I can ascend to your heights, Lady Urbosa! I will never stop trying to keep up with you. As your successor, I must not fail!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> Riju recalls her mother's stories about Vah Naboris being a guardian of the Gerudo,<ref>{{Cite|Long ago, my mother would tell me stories about Vah Naboris as a guardian deity of the Gerudo...|Riju|AoC}}</ref> to which Urbosa informs her that it was named after the [[Sage]] [[Nabooru]].<ref>{{Cite|Naboris is named after an ancient sage...and just like the sage, it helps us fight Calamity Ganon.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> After defeating all of the Guardians, Urbosa commends Riju for her courage,<ref>{{Cite|We did it! We really did it!|Riju|AoC}}<br/>{{Cite|Yes. Marvelously done, Riju. You showed true courage today.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> Riju states she was only so courageous because of Urbosa's help, before stating that they should continue to fight the rest of the Guardians.<ref>{{Cite|Oh! Only because I had your help, Lady Urbosa. Now let's go take out the remaining Guardians!|Riju|AoC}}</ref>

[[File:AoC Champions United.png|thumb|right|250px|alt= A screenshot of Riju and Urbosa looking at each other while standing atop Divine Beast Vah Naboris.|Riju and Urbosa]]
Following the completion of the [[Divine Beast]] section, the "[[Champions United]]" Movie plays. As Riju and Urbosa overlook the defeated Guardians, night falls, causing a horde of [[Stal]] [[Monster]]s to rise from the ground. More Guardians and Monsters also appear. Urbosa states that they are not having an easy time,<ref>{{Cite|They're not making this easy.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> but Riju attests that they will be able to stand their ground.<ref>{{Cite|Lady Urbosa! We have come so far. We must persevere until the battle's done!|Riju|AoC}}</ref> She calls Riju a "vai after [her] own heart"<ref>{{Cite|A vai after my own heart. You never give in, huh?|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> at which point a laser from Divine Beast Vah Medoh shoots across the sky. [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]] and [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]] arrive and launch their own attacks on the Guardians, causing Urbosa and Riju to laugh together. Urbosa makes a remark about how long they took.<ref>{{Cite|It's about time! What took them so long?|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref>

In the [[All Hyrule, United]] Scenario, Purah has not only restored the power to the Sheikah Towers, but she also supercharged them to summon the armies of all races, including the Champions and their Divine Beasts. Riju is notably more optimistic on how well things have gotten<ref>{{Cite|What a sight... I never imagined things could go this way.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> as Urbosa awaited orders from the princess.<ref>{{Cite|Awaiting your orders, Your Highness.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> With her father's blessing, Princess Zelda takes command of the army and gives them a pep speech before attacking the outposts and slaying the monsters that maintain the barrier so that the Champion Pilots can open fire with their Divine Beasts. Despite the Blood Moon reviving the fallen monsters and giving the Hyruleans a hard time, they managed to break through to Hyrule Castle.

In [[The Future of Hyrule]], As the ground and air forces storm towards the castle to confront the villains, Harbinger Ganon and Astor, who have put up much of a fight, but they are defeated. Astor's composure finally breaks as he orders the harbinger to consume the heroes, but he himself was consumed and some of the Malice takes control of Terrako and unwillingly turns on Link and Zelda. With Terrako badly damaged, Riju and the warriors take a moment of silence for its sake as Zelda vows to ensure that Calamity Ganon falls as they charge upstairs to deal with the beast waiting for them. At first, Ganon was too powerful for them due to reincarnating successfully to the point where Zelda attempted to use her power to seal it. It did, however, bring Terrako back up and rushes upstairs to sacrifice itself to destroy Ganon's defense, allowing the heroes to beat it down. Link uses the Master Sword to critically weaken Ganon enough for Zelda to finally destroy him forever. With Hyrule at peace once more, Terrako's blessed screw uses its power to send Riju, Teba, Yunobo, and Sidon back to the future. Urbosa and Riju exchange good-byes, with the former assuring the latter will do well to lead her people in the right direction,<ref>{{Cite|I know you'll lead our people well, Riju.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> with Riju replying that it was an honor to fight alongside her.<ref>{{Cite|I could not be prouder. It was an honor to be of service.|Riju|AoC}}</ref> She vanishes with the other three as the princess wishes them a better future.

In the {{GoR}} Scenario, "[[EX Liberate the Ancient Lab]]", Riju and Urbosa assist the Science Academy and the Sheikah by keeping the monsters and the Yiga Clan led by [[Master Kohga]]. After the dust clears, Urbosa compliments how well Riju handled the Thunder Helm.<ref>{{Cite|You've really gotten the hang of the helm, haven't you?|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> Riju was about to make a reply on her duties as the future [[Gerudo Chief]],<ref>{{Cite|As the chief, it's my responsibility to-|Riju|AoC}}</ref> before Kohga suddenly yanks it from her hands and places it on his top knot and dares Urbosa to use her lightning attack against him, claiming that it wouldn't work on him, but Urbosa knew that he doesn't know how to use it and manages to shock him anyway, allowing Riju to retrieve it. Master Kohga is flabbergasted that Urbosa actually struck him so easily despite having it while Urbosa shoots back that it would take him a hundred years for him to figure it out,<ref>{{Cite|One such as you would need a hundred years or more before you could wield this Helm.|Urbosa|AoC}}</ref> and Kohga pitches a fit and claims that he will have it even if it took him that long before vanishing, allowing both Gerudo Chiefs to catch a break.

In the secret Downloadable Content ending, Riju and Urbosa are surfing in the sands of Gerudo Desert on their sand-seals and enjoying every moment of it. Later Riju is seen interacting with the other Champions, present and future, as Terrako joins in amusing them.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==Trivia==
* Riju was designed by [[Yuko Miyakawa]], who decided to make her a child to contrast with the leaders of the other villages. Several of her accessories previously belonged to Urbosa, and she was designed to have both "dignity as the chief" and some "childishness appropriate to her age", like her love of Sand Seals.<ref name="CaC 137"/>
* A cutout of Riju was part of [[The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Scavenger Hunt|''The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom'' Scavenger Hunt]] at {{Wp|Rockefeller Center}}.<ref>{{Cite YouTube|quote= |title= The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Scavenger Hunt at Nintendo NY and Rockefeller Center |channel= @KirbyGCN17 |date= August 12, 2023 |url= https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KfSJ0GVYPZU |archive= https://web.archive.org/web/20240109053459/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KfSJ0GVYPZU }}</ref>
